# llms.txt - Gold Tracker System Specification
# Version: 1.0.0
# Date: 2026-09-27
# System: Gold Trading Performance Tracker & Analytics Cockpit

## Project Overview
Gold Tracker is a client-side mobile-first web application designed for spot gold (XAUUSD) traders. It replaces manual spreadsheets with dynamic capital partitioning, five-day market week tracking, performance-only dynamic targets, forward 20-22 day statistical projections, period comparisons, and a trading journal. It supports cross-device persistence via direct GitHub repository API synchronization and local storage fallback.

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: Semantic HTML5, CSS3 Custom Properties (Glassmorphic dark design tokens), Modern Vanilla JavaScript (ES6+ Modules)
- Storage: LocalStorage and GitHub REST API (direct read/write to repository data.json)
- Deployment Target: GitHub Pages

## Target Keywords
Gold Trading Journal, XAUUSD Performance Tracker, Daily PnL Logger, Dynamic Trading Targets, Forex Risk Management, Trading Rulebook CRUD, GitHub Pages Trading Cockpit

## Content Policies & Privacy
- All financial metrics and trading rules are private and stored on the user device or within the user private GitHub repository.
- No third-party analytical tracking or remote data harvesting.

## Key APIs & Endpoints
- GitHub Contents API: https://api.github.com/repos/{owner}/{repo}/contents/{path}
- Web Storage API: window.localStorage
